RECOMMENDATION: RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 50

That number reflects uncertainty, not a measured probability; these facts cannot establish whether sex influenced the decision.

An all-male panel is worth questioning as a process concern, but it is not proof of discrimination. Your longer experience matters, although relevant digital expertise could legitimately outweigh years served.

Follow up in writing now. Request the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and the broadcaster’s policy on panel composition. Frame the panel question neutrally: “What safeguards ensured a fair assessment without sex bias?”

Keep records. If you’re considering a formal challenge, promptly check local deadlines with your union or an equality adviser; awaiting an explanation may not pause them.
